title: Magnit Market Lost One Ruble for Every Two Rubles of Revenue
subtitle: Its 2024 loss equaled about one third of an implied 9.5 billion ruble cost base before the marketplace was narrowed into Magnit’s “extended shelf” model.

source.name: Magnit Market seller FAQ and Kommersant

supportingFacts.label: Magnit said the service would cease operating as a broad marketplace and become an extended assortment for its core retail business.
The transition moved sellers to fulfillment by seller and stopped new warehouse intake in July.
Wildberries reportedly withdrew from the planned Magnit Market transaction.
Wildberries also reportedly suspended acquisition and investment activity.

note: The implied cost base is derived as 2024 revenue plus the reported net loss. It is used as a high-level funding view, not an accounting expense reconciliation.

metadata.keyFinding: Magnit Market entered its narrower 2026 operating model after a loss equal to roughly half its 2024 revenue.
